settings.title: Settings

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account?
deleteAccount.intro: This permanently deletes, with no way back:
deleteAccount.hikes: all your hikes and planned routes, with their GPX files
deleteAccount.interactions: your kudos and comments, and those on your hikes
deleteAccount.downloadFirst: Download your hikes first if you want to keep them.
deleteAccount.confirmDescription: Type <email>{{email}}</email> and your password to delete your account for good.

sessions.title: Active sessions

sessions.signOutFailed: Could not sign out that device

errors.registration_closed: Sign-up is closed; ask the admin for an invite.

auth.closedDescription: This instance is invite-only. Ask its admin to invite you.
auth.verifySent: We sent a link to <email>{{email}}</email>. Open it to confirm your email and sign in. It expires after 24 hours; signing in again after that sends a new one.
auth.askAdminDescription: This instance does not send emails. An admin can give you a link to choose a new password.

admin.registrationDescription: Set by the REGISTRATION_ENABLED environment variable. Restart the app after changing it.
admin.inviteOnlyHint: Nobody can sign up on their own. Invite people from the list below.
admin.emailOff: No mail server is set up (SMTP_HOST). Accounts sign in without verifying their email, and nothing is emailed: copy invite and password links from each user’s page.
admin.emailOn: Verification, invite and password reset emails are sent through SMTP_HOST.
admin.banDescription: They are signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until you lift the ban. Their hikes stay as they are.
admin.reasonHint: Shown to them when they try to sign in.
admin.revokeDescription: The link sent to <email>{{email}}</email> stops working and their pending account is deleted. You can invite this email again later.
admin.linkEmailed: We emailed this link to {{email}}. You can also share it yourself.
admin.linkEmailFailed: The email to {{email}} could not be sent. Share this link with them instead.
admin.linkShare: Share this link with {{email}} so they can choose a password.
admin.linkExpiresDay: It works once and expires in 24 hours.
admin.linkExpiresWeek: It works once and expires in 7 days.
admin.passwordLinkDescription: A link to choose a new password, for when they forgot theirs. Their current password keeps working until they use it.
admin.inviteDescription: Creates their account, even when sign-up is closed. They choose a password through the invite link.
admin.userGone: This user does not exist anymore.
admin.actionsSelf: This is you. Ask another admin to change your role.
admin.emailStatusFailed: Could not change the email status
admin.sessionsSelf: Manage your own sessions from Settings.
admin.sessionsDescription: Devices this user is signed in on. Signing them out does not stop them signing in again; ban them for that.
